append.detail: Built 2026-11-16. lib/hunts/partners.ts holds the rules: an invite is bound to one Hunt, one Space and one named steward (hunt_partners.invitee_profile_id), with no token, so acceptance checks the signed-in person is that steward and is an owner or active admin of the Space at that moment; a forwarded link reads as a 404 and writes nothing. The invite pins the terms version (sha256 of docs/hunts/PARTNER-AGREEMENT.md in terms_version) and acceptance is refused when the terms changed or are not owner approved. lib/hunts/partner-store.ts does invite, accept, decline, withdraw and the organiser's revoke as conditional updates with a hunt_audit row each. Publish (lib/hunts/store.ts) refuses a stop at a venue Space with no live partner row. Migration 20270346075000_hunt_partner_state.sql (not applied) adds the steward column and one refusal to hunt_claim_apply, venue_not_active, so a withdrawn, suspended or unanswered venue gets no new proof while earlier progress and its replay stay; supabase/tests/hunt_partner_state.test.sql proves it. Screens: /hunts/edit/<id>/partners and /hunts/partners/<hunt>/<space>, dark behind HUNTS_AUTHORING_ENABLED. Acceptance is closed in every environment until the agreement is owner approved (FH-028S); opening it, and showing the full approved terms on the accept screen, is FH-029S.
